title: Wither Storm Control
description: This project allows you to control the Wither Storm. This works on multiplayer without installing the mod on your victims' computer.
body:
# The Wither Storm Control Mod

> **Note:** This mod does **not** add any new content. It simply allows players to take control of the Wither Storm—whether for experimentation, chaos, or just trolling your friends.

**Multiplayer Compatible:** The mod works on multiplayer servers without requiring every player to install it. However, if you want to properly control a Wither Storm, the mod must be installed on the client of the player piloting it.

---

# Getting Started

## Requirement

This mod requires **Cracker's Wither Storm Mod**:

https://modrinth.com/mod/crackers-wither-storm-mod

---

## Taking Control of a Wither Storm

1. Summon a Wither Storm.
2. Run the following command (requires **operator permissions**):

```mcfunction
/pilot @w true
```

### Command Arguments

| Argument | Description                                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `pilot`  | The command name                                                   |
| `@w`     | Cracker's Wither Storm selector (targets the closest Wither Storm) |
| `true`   | Enables player control (`false` returns control to the AI)         |

---

# Controls
These can be changed in the keybinds tab
Default keybinds while piloting a Wither Storm:

| Key | Function                                            |
| --- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `M` | Toggle tracking                                     |
| `B` | Fire powered skulls from every connected head       |
| `N` | Fire normal wither skulls from every connected head |
| `[` | Decrease projectile spread                          |
| `]` | Increase projectile spread                          |
